history.title: Our history
history.subtitle: Half a century of public schooling
history.intro: From a neighbourhood school born of community activism to the educational project that now welcomes our families. This is the story you keep writing with us every day.

origins.title: A school born from the neighbourhood
origins.p1: In the early 70s, the Falguera neighbourhood was growing with the local factories. Families arriving from across the country had no school places: more than 600 children had to take a bus to Barcelona every morning.
origins.p2: Local families organised and demanded a public school. The pressure worked: in 1971 the land was granted and construction began, right behind Palau Falguera.

quote.text: "The school went from Francoist to Catalan, and the neighbourhood from having nothing to being full of life."
quote.author: Falguera neighbourhood chronicle

modelo.title: The "school without doors"
modelo.fact: "schools without doors" in all of Spain
modelo.p1: The original building was an experimental project: open classrooms, large windows, natural light and shared spaces. One of only five of its kind in the entire country.
modelo.p2: The school grew to over 1,000 students and 38 teachers. So much life couldn't fit in one open space, and over time walls were added to create traditional classrooms.

1971.title: Construction begins
1971.desc: The City Council grants the land behind Palau Falguera to build a new public school.

1972.title: Colegio Modelo opens
1972.desc: On December 11th, one of the country's five "schools without doors" opens its gates.

1976.title: First Catalan lessons
1976.desc: Catalan is introduced in the classroom for the first time.

1985.title: Catalan immersion
1985.desc: The school fully joins the Catalan immersion programme and moves to two classes per grade.

1988.title: New name: Escola Falguera
1988.desc: The community decides to rename the school to honour the neighbourhood and mark a new era.

1997.title: New building
1997.desc: The school moves to a new building on Sant Josep street, coinciding with its 25th anniversary.

2012.title: Major renovation
2012.desc: Classrooms and common areas are modernised for current pedagogical needs.

2022.title: 50 years of school
2022.desc: Half a century of educational community in the Falguera neighbourhood.

name.title: From "Colegio Modelo" to Escola Falguera
name.desc: The community chose to rename the school to claim the neighbourhood, leave behind the connotations of an earlier era, and put down roots where the families live.
name.label: Falguera

today.title: A school in constant action
today.intro: Half a century on, Falguera is still a living project, rooted in the neighbourhood and open to the world.

green.title: Green School
green.desc: School garden, sustainability and outdoor activities thanks to our proximity to the river and Collserola.

cordes.title: Strings Project
cordes.desc: String instrument lessons in the classroom, in partnership with Palau Falguera's Municipal Music School.

steam.title: STE(AI)M
steam.desc: Science, technology, art and AI integrated into the curriculum through hands-on experiences.

community.title: AFA Community
community.desc: After-school, drop-off care and an in-house kitchen: families make daily life at school possible.

palau.title: Why "Falguera"?
palau.p1: The school is named after Palau Falguera, a 17th-century estate at the historic heart of Sant Feliu. It sits right next to us and shapes the cultural landscape of the school.
palau.p2: Today, Palau Falguera hosts the Municipal Music School and the National Rose Exhibition. Its gardens are a natural extension of our classrooms.

accounts.title: Accounts 2025-2026
accounts.intro: The outgoing Board ends its term with AFA fully solvent, all suppliers paid and enough funds for the new Board to start comfortably.

stats.label: Solvency
stats.desc: No debts and no outstanding payments to suppliers.

stats.label: 1st part of the grant
stats.desc: Received days before the assembly. The second part (about €2,500) will not arrive before September.

stats.label: Study support and Library
stats.desc: Main item of the municipal grant, with a single supplier.

stats.label: Free allocation
stats.desc: Decided together with the school: robotics, Year 6 drums or games, depending on the year.

items: AFA pays suppliers upfront until the municipal grant arrives, which since the pandemic is received close to the end of the year. That is why a financial cushion is needed.
The Agenda 21 allocation is small and goes to items such as soil for the school garden or books, depending on the year.

With this year's margin, giant wooden games were bought outside the grant to liven up spaces such as the dining hall. The school has integrated them into daily life and a new allocation for games is planned.
Payments for after-school activities and morning care were settled that same week: overpayments are refunded and outstanding amounts claimed.
Membership fees went from under 20 % of families to almost all of them; only two primary families chose not to join (P3, P4 and P5 are not included as they do not use reusable books).

thanks.title: Acknowledgements
thanks.desc: During the first year of the term, the Falguera Neighbours' Association and the AFA of Escola Salvador Espriu were key to overcoming the deficit: at several charity events, the funds raised by Escola Falguera were given entirely to AFA.

projects.title: Term review
projects.intro: Main projects from the outgoing Board's four years.

items.title: Presence in the neighbourhood
items.desc: AFA is part of the Falguera Neighbours' Association and takes part in local projects and festivals.

items.title: Giant and big-head figures
items.desc: The original head of the giant was preserved and a new one was built. Families voted to portray Valentina Tereshkova, and AFA added a big-head figure, «la fada de la natura». Bringing back the drummers is still pending.

items.title: School parking
items.desc: Around five drop-off spaces were secured at the entrance. Families should report any misuse to AFA.

items.title: Facade painting
items.desc: A joint project with Institut Olorda: art students designed the proposal, with green and robotics motifs. It is approved by the school and the city council and is expected to be finished before September.

items.title: Festivals and events
items.desc: Castanya Week, the second-hand market, the chocolate party and Enric Falguera, among others.

items.title: DANA relief drive
items.desc: Together with AFA Gaudí, a town-wide donation drive filled a trailer with clothes, medicine and supplies in just a few days.

items.title: AFA website
items.desc: afafalguera.com, built during this transition year as a communication channel beyond WhatsApp and to digitalise bookings and after-school registrations.

items.title: School camps
items.desc: In 2024 AFA ran its own weekend camps open to several year groups to keep prices down. This year, for the first time in many years, all three planned year groups went on camp.

board.title: New Board
board.intro: Presented at the assembly and approved by vote of those present.
board.note: The new Board wants to build on the work done and add improvements, and invites more families to join, either with a role or through the committees.

items.title: Books and supplies
items.desc: The school has emailed each year group with amounts and dates. Supplies are paid to the school; AFA collects reusable books and the membership fee. The payment deadline is 31 August.

items.title: Bookshops
items.desc: AFA usually works with the Ginger Blau bookshop, which offers flexibility (combining non-nominal book vouchers or buying for several siblings at once), but books can be bought anywhere.

items.title: Field trips
items.desc: Managed directly by the school (contact Ramón) and normally split into three payments.

agreements.title: Resolutions
items: The 2025-2026 year-end accounts are approved and AFA is recorded as fully solvent.
The new Board is formally constituted with the composition above.
The 31 August deadline for supplies, books and membership fee payments is confirmed.
agreements.signature: Minutes signed by the secretary, Alberto Ruiz Castillo, approved by the president, Adela Montes Segarra.
